purpose: Centralize the authority-bearing release-head and rollback attestation job in Shine Core so app callers cannot silently change attestation logic.
invariants: App-local callers may choose only registered target and source-branch inputs; they do not own the attestation implementation.
The authority workflow is referenced by immutable Core commit SHA, never a branch or mutable tag.
Caller repository identity remains independently verified; reusable workflow authority does not replace repository binding.
A future central workflow revision receives a new SHA and must be deliberately promoted before it can exercise authority.
Release-head and rollback OIDC tokens without the exact pinned Core reusable workflow authority are rejected.
Authority-gated runtime consumers import one shared immutable authority binding; they do not duplicate the authority ref or SHA locally.

enforcement.rotationRule: Rotate the shared runtime binding and this contract together; CI rejects contract/runtime divergence before merge.

runtimeBinding.role: Single runtime source of truth for the immutable Core reusable-workflow authority ref and SHA.
